_setup_notes: To enable MCP browser automation set 'enabled' to true and configure the path below.
Install the Antigravity MCP server: npm install -g @antigravity/mcp-server-operator
Then set args to the resolved path: node -e "console.log(require.resolve('@antigravity/mcp-server-operator'))"
Or use npx: set command to 'npx' and args to ['@antigravity/mcp-server-operator'].
While enabled=false, Tier 2 and Tier 3 fall back to interactive manual confirmation.
